Message.Name: Trade Publication Message
Message.Description: A trade publication message is sent by the reporting system whenever a trade is reported

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the Trade generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: VenueOfExecution
Field.Description: Identification of the venue where the transaction was executed

Field.Name: InstrumentIdCodeType
Field.Description: Code type used to identify the financial instrument Always equal to 'ISIN'

Field.Name: PriceMultiplier
Field.Description: Number of units of the financial instrument that are contained a trading lot (to be calculated with the MultiplierScaleCode)

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds

Field.Name: TradingDateTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was executed

Field.Name: PriceCurrency
Field.Description: Currency in which the price is expressed (applicable if the price is expressed as monetary value)

Field.Name: InstrumentIdCode
Field.Description: ISIN code used to identify the financial instrument, as defined in ISO 6166

Field.Name: PublicationDateTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was published by a trading venue Date and time in the following format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.ddddddZ. - 'YYYY' is the year; - 'MM' is the month; - 'DD' is the day; - 'T' – means that the letter 'T' shall be used - 'hh' is the hour; - 'mm' is the minute; - 'ss.dddddd' is the second and its fraction of a second; - Z is UTC time

Field.Name: NotionalCurrency
Field.Description: Currency in which the notional is denominated as defined by ISO 4217

Field.Name: TCSTradeID
Field.Description: Unique reference of the trade

Field.Name: PriceNotation
Field.Description: Indication as to whether the price and the strike price is expressed in monetary value, in percentage or in yield

Field.Name: Filller
Field.Description: For future use

Field.Name: TransactionToBeCleared
Field.Description: Code to identify whether the transaction will be cleared

Field.Name: MMTBenchmarkIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the benchmark indicator or the reference price indicator following MMT level 3.5

Field.Name: MMTContributionToPrice
Field.Description: Defines the contribution to price or the price discovery process following MMT level 3.8

Field.Name: MultiplierScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with PriceMultiplier

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Traded price of the transaction excluding, where applicable, commission and accrued interest

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Replacing Volume Number of units of the financial instrument

Field.Name: NotionalAmount
Field.Description: Nominal amount or notional amount

Field.Name: TransactionIDCode
Field.Description: Alphanumerical code assigned by trading venue used in any subsequent reference to the specific trade

Field.Name: MMTMarketMechanism
Field.Description: Defines the market mechanism following MMT level 1

Field.Name: MMTTradingMode
Field.Description: Defines the trading Mode mechanism following MMT level 2 Possible values: - '1': Undefined Auction (not used) - 'O': Scheduled Opening Auction - 'K': Scheduled Closing Auction - 'I': Scheduled Intraday Auction (not used) - 'U': Unscheduled Auction - '2': Continuous Trading - '3': At Market Close Trading - '4': Out of Main Session Trading (not used) - '5': Trade Reporting (On Exchange) - '6': Trade Reporting (Off Exchange) - '7': Trade Reporting (Systematic Internaliser) (not used) - '-': None apply

Field.Name: MMTSpecialDividendIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the special dividend indicator following MMT level 3.6

Field.Name: MMTNegotiationIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the negotiation indicator or pre-trade transparency waiver following MMT level 3.2

Field.Name: MMTAgencyCrossIndicator
Field.Description: Transactions where an investment firm has brought together clients' orders with the purchase and the sale conducted as one transaction and involving the same volume and price

Field.Name: MMTTransactionCategory
Field.Description: Defines the transaction category following MMT level 3.1

Field.Name: MMTModificationIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the modification indicator following MMT level 3.4

Field.Name: MMTDuplicativeIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the duplicative indicator following MMT level 5

Field.Name: MMTPublicationMode
Field.Description: Defines the publication mode or post- trade deferral reason following MMT level 4.1

Field.Name: MMTAlgorithmicIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the algorithmic indicator following MMT level 3.9

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: An Auction Summary message summarizes an instrument's opening or auction trades

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: Specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: FirstPrice
Field.Description: First traded price for the current trading day (To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: LastPrice
Field.Description: Most recent traded price for the current trading day (until the message is sent)

Field.Name: HighestPrice
Field.Description: Highest traded price for the current trading day (To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: LowestPrice
Field.Description: Lowest traded price for the current trading day (To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: CumulativeQuantity
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity traded for the current trading day (does not take into account hidden quantity)

Field.Name: Variation
Field.Description: Percentage variation of the last trade price against the previous day's reference price for the instrument (signed) concerned, ie the last known price or the last price indication (variation price).(To be calculated with the VariationScaleCode)

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds

Field.Name: TypeOfLastPrice
Field.Description: Indicates the message trade type

Field.Name: TickDirection
Field.Description: Indicates how the last price has moved as compared to the preceding last traded price

Field.Name: InstrumentValuationPrice
Field.Description: Indicates whether the data item "last price" is a valuation price following a valuation trade

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to all prices in the message

Field.Name: VariationScaleCode
Field.Description: Available for the price variation in the message

Message.Name: Vwap Closing Price Message
Message.Description: This message contains the Volume-Weighted Average Price for an instrument, along with few statistical information related to the cumulated traded value and volume

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SendingIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates the "sending mode"

Field.Name: ClosingPriceRule
Field.Description: Indicates the Closing Price calculation rule

Field.Name: ClosingPrice
Field.Description: Current VWAP/Closing Price (To be calculated with the ScaleCode) Not Provided for Derivatives

Field.Name: AdjustedClosingPrice
Field.Description: Adjusted VWAP/Closing Price (To be calculated with the ScaleCode)

Field.Name: NbTrades
Field.Description: Number of Trades executed on this Instrument since the beginning of the Trading Day

Field.Name: AmountTraded
Field.Description: Total cumulated amount traded on this instrument since the beginning of the Trading day (To be calculated with the ScaleCode) Not Provided for Derivatives

Field.Name: QtyShares
Field.Description: Cumulated Quantity traded (number of securities) on this instrument since the beginning of the Trading Day Not Provided for Derivatives

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: ScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to ClosingPrice, AdjustedClosingPrice and AmountTraded

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Reserved for future use
